$comment: One template for every repo's GitHub Project, from docs/project-boards.md (ADR 0024). The board's columns are the Stage issue field. Status is aligned with Stage both ways by the reconciler (issue 78); no script writes it on items. Priority is the org number field 1-100 (100 = do first).

views.name: Needs me
views.manual: Group by Stage. Sort by Priority descending (100 first).

views.name: Flow
views.manual: Column field: Stage (test T8: drag a card and check the issue's Stage changed). Sort by Priority descending. Column limit 1 on Working (test T11).

views.name: Epics
views.manual: Group by Milestone. Sort by Priority descending.

workflows: Set these after build: build replaces the Status options, and a workflow set before it loses its value (red !).
Item added to project → Status: OFF (through the reconciler it would overwrite Stage)
Auto-add to project: this repo, filter is:issue is:open (ON; test T10: the filter is accepted)
Item reopened, Pull request linked to issue, Pull request merged, Code changes requested, Code review approved (OFF)
access: Settings → Manage access: base role No access; the owner is the only admin.
